title: Repeated Returned Payments across a Household's Larkspur Accounts
content:
**Resident Accounts note — Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement and Independent Living Residency Agreement households.**

Repeated returns raise the returned-payment charge. Two counts are taken over the 12 whole months before the handling date:

- **the assisted living account:** the returned payments reinstated on the assisted living residency, other than the one being charged;
- **the independent living account:** the returned payments reinstated on the customer's Larkspur independent living account under the Independent Living Residency Agreement.

| Returned payments in the window | Multiplier of the charge |
|---|---|
| Two or more on either account | 1.5 |
| One on either account (and fewer than two on each) | 1.25 |
| None on either account | Unchanged |

The two accounts are tested separately, not added together. The multiplier acts on the charge before it is rounded once to the cent.

**The window.** A return counts when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posting date from the handling date, a whole month being completed each time the count reaches the same day of the month as the posting date.

### Truth table (hypothetical counts)

| Other returns, assisted living | Returns, independent living | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | Unchanged |
| 1 | 0 | 1.25 |
| 0 | 1 | 1.25 |
| 1 | 1 | 1.25 |
| 2 | 0 | 1.5 |
| 0 | 3 | 1.5 |
